title: Verify: characterSchema interaction unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the optional character interaction field
description: Add game/tests/characterSchema.test.ts testing characterSchema with and without interaction, using pure in-memory inputs and no I/O.
acceptance_criteria: Tests assert absent, dialogue, actions and invalid cases
Tests pass with the command below

steps.action: Create a describe block with a base character fixture (id 'boy', name 'Boy', position {x:1,y:2}, animations.idle {asset:'character:boy', animation:'idle'}). Test 1: parse base without interaction, expect interaction undefined. Test 2: add interaction {dialogue:'npc-greeting'}, expect result.interaction.dialogue toBe 'npc-greeting'. Test 3: add interaction {actions:[{id:'inspect',label:'Talk',events:[]}]}, expect actions length 1 and id 'inspect'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterSchema.test.ts

steps.action: Add tests: interaction {dialogue:5} throws via expect(() => characterSchema.parse(...)).toThrow(); interaction {actions:[{id:'dance',label:'x',events:[]}]} also throws.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterSchema.test.ts
